# Fission

> Rent machines and run tasks with your coding agent. Built-in Foundry, Reth and Tempo setup, plus custom Linux environments. Payments use MPP on Tempo.

Normal interface:
- `fission` — Rust dashboard
- `fission install` — install the agent skill
- `fission rent NAME ...` — prepare a machine for access; preview before approval
- `fission ssh NAME` — connect to a ready machine
- `fission run NAME ... -- ARGV` — preview by default; `--approve` executes
- `fission status [NAME] [--resume] [--wait DURATION]`
- `fission stop NAME`
- `fission budget`
- `fission help COMMAND`

Everything manual or low-level is `fission advanced COMMAND`.

Documentation:
- [README](README.md)
- [Harnesses](docs/harnesses.md)
- [Rental safety and recovery](docs/rental.md)
- [Synced Ethereum with Reth/Lighthouse](docs/reth.md)
- [Installation](docs/install.md)
- [Agent skill](skills/fission/SKILL.md)

Preview before approval. Preserve retained accounting and ambiguous outcomes. A local sleep pauses supervision but not remote deadlines. Cleanup is complete only when provider termination is confirmed.
